latin: Iupiter de quo in Gorgia, non est ille qui est uniuersalis conditor, tertius inter intellectuales, sed summus et primus inter ducales.
translation: The Jupiter spoken of in the Gorgias is not the one who is the universal creator, third among the intellectual gods, but the highest and first among the leader-gods.
